. A screenshot shows none of them rendered, yet snapshot.text and snapshot.selection contain all of them (hidden_text count 8 covers only other cases). Feeding that snapshot through tests.assist.test_a0_access_perception mk()/grant(observe)/ask_and_wait gives status COMPLETE and each payload occurs twice in FakeClient.bodies. Root cause: visible() relies on checkVisibility(opacityProperty) which only catches opacity:0 (not filter/mask/near-zero opacity); the clip-path regex /inset\(\s*(50%|100%)/ only matches a leading 50%/100% inset; textVisible checks only alpha(color), not -webkit-text-fill-color; closed-details slot content returns client rects. None of these are in the documented 'Not covered' list, and docs/assist/03 row claims opacity, transparent text colour and clip-path inset are covered.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat effective opacity (product of ancestor opacity and filter:opacity) below a small threshold as hidden; treat -webkit-text-fill-color alpha 0 like transparent colour; for clip-path parse every inset side (and treat circle/ellipse/polygon with zero area, or any non-inset shape conservatively) and check mask-image/-webkit-mask; exclude text inside a closed <details> other than its <summary>; add these cases to a self-contained Chromium regression test and make the docs/03 coverage claims match the code exactly.
findings.title: In-page hidden-text filter still misses fully invisible text (filter:opacity(0), -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent, non-leading/other clip-path insets and shapes, transparent mask-image, closed <details> content, near-zero opacity); injected instructions reach the Brain request as 'Visible text' and 'Selected text' (R11-01 class not closed)
